upstream.license_copy: Byte-for-byte copy of the pinned upstream LICENSE.

hash_rules.source_normalization: Decode UTF-8; replace CRLF and CR with LF; preserve all other characters, whitespace and final newlines; encode UTF-8.
hash_rules.original_normalized_sha256: Normalized original archive member, before any local patch or provenance header.
hash_rules.reviewed_normalized_sha256: Normalized reviewed dependency-cache source, including both existing fixes and the instructions.mbt capability wrapper before removal.
hash_rules.vendored_sha256: Normalized complete vendored file, including SPDX/provenance and modification comments.

internal_contract.diagnostics: ParserError variants, Show implementation and Show extensions are unchanged from 0.14.0; the error type belongs to the internal parser package.

Replace recursive read_expr/read_if_then_body and structured read_instruction cases with an ExprFrame stack for Block, Loop, IfThen, IfElse and TryTable; retain complete AST bodies, block types and catch handlers without adding a depth limit.

Preserve non-control opcode/immediate parsing and catch-handler decoding; unmatched or repeated else raises UnknownOpcode(0x05), end closes a frame or the outer expression, and truncated input raises UnexpectedEndOfInput.
Remove the reviewed cache's parse_module_iterative capability wrapper; keep the original parse_module entrypoint in sections.mbt.
Make the implementation-only ExprFrame enum private to satisfy first-party missing_priv warning checks; format its tuple fields with pinned moon fmt; behavior is unchanged.
Route ref.null heaptype resolution through resolve_heap_type_as_ref_value_type(nullable=true), preserving the existing read order, AST constructors and invalid heap type errors.

upstream_source_references.relationship: Upstream source fix for the same singleton self-reference bug. This vendor retains the reviewed local 0.14.0 placeholder patch, not the upstream refactoring of both branches.

Upstream source reference for explicit expression frames. This vendor retains the reviewed local 0.14.0 ExprFrame implementation, with inline catch-handler decoding and without the downstream capability wrapper.

publication_status.note: The registry lists 0.16.0 as latest, published before both 2026-09-18 source commits. No later published replacement is listed. Source commits are provenance references, not evidence of a published replacement dependency.
